description: Page-restrictions modal with a restriction-mode selector, controls to add user or group subjects with a permission level, and an editable, removable entry list, loading and saving through the permission provider.

parameters.name: Visible
parameters.description: Controls whether the dialog is visible.

parameters.name: EffectivePermission
parameters.description: Effective permission displayed by the dialog when inherited.

parameters.name: OnSaved
parameters.description: Raised after restrictions are saved successfully.

parameters.name: PageId
parameters.description: Page identifier whose restrictions are edited.

parameters.name: Provider
parameters.description: Provider used for loading and saving restrictions.
